$comment: THE ENGINE FILES - the one list of what the app downloads on first use and never bundles. Read by engines/files.ts (the app), scripts/models/publish.mjs (uploads them) and scripts/release.mjs (refuses to ship while any is missing). Paths are under the product's models host (`identity.hosts.models`); a new export goes to a new version prefix (v2), never over v1. Changing a file here or bumping onnxruntime-web means: pnpm models:publish BEFORE pnpm release.
